name: losandes-pi-crust
description: Run a structured SDLC of autonomous, specialist AI agents in your repo. Watch it run, ask it questions, and steer it in mid-flight with the included web app. Revisit past sessions, branch new ones, or dive into how it produced it's outcomes with SQLite traces and archived sessions files.
